cand.title: 26th Joseph Sandler Psychoanalytic Research Conference 2026
cand.excerpt: Three-day research conference at Victoria College with international speakers, plenaries, poster sessions, registration fees, hosted meals, coffee breaks, a wine-and-cheese reception, and two named accommodation hotels.
cand.selectionWhy: Prior blocked-promising candidate (no exact date/contact in thin ledger)

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Stephen Leibow: Director, Toronto Institute of Psychoanalysis, named in conference welcome/closure material; relevant local-host decision-maker/referral candidate. Siri Erika Gullestad: Chair, IPA Research Committee, explicitly named among conference organizers; relevant series-level relationship for future hosts and planning pathways. Neither is verified as the hotel-contract signatory or accommodation buyer.
findings.futureEdition: None officially announced was found for 2026-12-06 through June 2028. The 26th edition took place October 16–18, 2026; the current IPA research page explicitly says “This took place 16-18 October 2026.” No next-edition exact dates, city or venue were located. Do not roll these historical dates forward.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied hotel specifications: a city-based academic conference is more relevant than a resort proposition, but the university-campus location and programme-listed hotels near the site weaken the Harbourfront hotel’s convenience advantage. A small faculty/VIP lodging group, optional delegate lodging or a separately agreed side meeting could fit the 157-room property; there is no evidence for a 15–109-room block, whole-event housing, or any specific room demand. Attendance is unpublished, so the event cannot responsibly be classified as too large or too small. Do not pitch relocation of all plenaries without attendance and layout requirements; do not promise catering or restaurant/lounge availability.
findings.venueCommitments: Historical commitment: Victoria College / Victoria University in the University of Toronto, 73 Queen’s Park Crescent East, Toronto, Ontario M5S 1K7, Canada. Programme identifies Old Vic Foyer and Alumni Hall for reception activity. This is Toronto proper, on the St. George campus in the Queen’s Park/Bloor area of the broader downtown, not Harbourfront, MTCC or Exhibition Place. University venue, not a competing hotel. No future venue commitment found.
findings.historicalRotation: Verified edition sequence: 24th, November 1–3, 2024, Shanghai, China, Chateau Star River; 25th, September 19–21, 2025, Buenos Aires, Argentina, Asociación Psicoanalítica Argentina, hybrid; 26th, October 16–18, 2026, Toronto, Canada, Victoria College/Victoria University. This establishes recurrence and destination changes in those years, not a guaranteed annual future schedule or a Toronto return.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Historical 2026 edition-specific recommendations, not proven contracted room blocks. The October programme states: “The following hotels are within a 10-minute walk of the site” and “Request the University of Toronto Conference Rate”, naming Kimpton St. George Hotel and The Yorkville Royal Sonesta Hotel Toronto. The March programme also lists The Anndore House – JDV by Hyatt (printed as “The Andorre House”), Park Hyatt Toronto, The Hazelton Hotel Toronto, and The Four Seasons Hotel Toronto: six distinct hotels across the reviewed 2026 programmes. No numerical rate, allocation, cutoff, pickup, exclusive housing contract, housing bureau, PCO or open hotel RFP was found. The February seed lists only the first two hotels. Recommendations and a conference-rate request do not establish booked inventory or exclusivity.
findings.organizationStructure: Association-led scientific/education event: IPA Research Committee organizes; Toronto Institute of Psychoanalysis hosts; Victoria University supplies the venue. TPS is a not-for-profit professional association; TIP comprises senior TPS training and supervising analysts and was established as a branch of the Canadian Institute of Psychoanalysis. No commercial agency, PCO, DMC or housing bureau is identified in the reviewed edition materials.
findings.competitiveLimitations: The published hotel recommendations prioritize proximity to the campus; Radisson Blu is not listed. The October programme emphasizes a 10-minute walk and a University of Toronto Conference Rate at the two named hotels. These are competitive recommendations, not evidence of exclusive contracts. The event page says “CONFERENCE IS SOLD OUT – REGISTRATION IS CLOSED”; this refers to registration, not hotel sellout. No evidence of hotel compression, denied bookings, overflow referrals or unmet accommodation demand was found.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Relationship development only: send a post-event introduction to the published TIP conference inbox, sandlerconference2026@gmail.com, requesting referral to Stephen Leibow and the person responsible for hotel arrangements. Ask for 2026 non-local attendance, actual hotel pickup/room nights, faculty lodging process and any future Toronto hosting mandate. Ask Siri Erika Gullestad or the IPA Research Committee about the next host-selection cycle. Only after a Toronto return and sourcing access are confirmed, offer a limited faculty/VIP or delegate rate proposal; verify restaurant/catering operations before including meals. Do not pursue an expired 2026 room block or assume a Toronto 2027 return.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: Closed/past as of November 15, 2026 and outside the requested horizon. The organizer labels registration sold out/closed and IPA confirms the event took place. No current-edition lodging sale remains actionable.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Conditional inference only. International destination rotation means a subsequent Sandler edition is not automatically Toronto demand. Retain TIP as a local-host relationship and monitor official IPA/TIP announcements. A future Toronto edition or separate local programme could justify a small lodging proposal, but neither is established here as an upcoming opportunity.
